notes:
Planning a November trip to the Japanese Alps/Nagano Prefecture with friends from Tokyo for a few days; considering public transport (S1.U2). Chose Matsumoto over Hakuba for traditional culture/history, easier transit, and proximity to the Japanese Alps Visitor Center (S1.U3–U4). Wants to visit the Visitor Center, Matsumoto Castle, Nawate Street, and if possible, the Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum and Zenko-ji Temple (S1.U5–U6). Interested in traditional Japanese architecture, history, temples, shrines, and castles; asked whether to prioritize the castle or temple (S1.U5–U6). Earlier bases considered: Nagano/Hakuba, Kita-Nagano, Kamikochi, Matsumoto, Hakuba, and Nagano City (S1.U1). Sought Matsumoto-area onsen and historical-site recommendations (S1.U4–U5).

Lives in Tokyo; moved into a studio apartment in Harajuku and has lived there 3 months (3 months supersedes 1 month, S2.U2; originally S1.U3). Commute is very convenient; still adjusting to Tokyo but enjoys independence (S1.U3). Enjoys Tokyo’s fall foliage, which differs from home; explores a new neighborhood each Sunday and found a good Daikanyama coffee shop (S2.U1). Hasn’t explored Harajuku’s historical side much; plans to visit
